fusions.name: Split Ply
fusions.desc: Looses 2 split strands spread wide, each dealing 4 damage. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Crossing Snare
fusions.desc: Throws crossed threads at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 10 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Detour Curtain
fusions.desc: Hangs a 5-tile curtain ahead of you that nothing crosses for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Double Stitch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
